description: Professional transactional, lifecycle, product, billing, and service emails for software and technology businesses.
placeholder_format: Use double-brace variables, for example {{customer_name}}. Replace every placeholder before sending.

templates.name: Account Welcome
templates.subject: Welcome to {{product_name}}
templates.body:
Dear {{user_name}},

Welcome to {{product_name}}. Your account has been created successfully.

You can now access your workspace and explore the tools and features available to you.

Access your account: {{login_url}}

For assistance, visit {{help_center_url}} or contact {{support_email}}.

Best regards,
Customer Success Team
{{company_name}}

templates.name: Email Verification
templates.trigger: When a user registers or changes their email address
templates.subject: Confirm Your Email Address
templates.body:
Dear {{user_name}},

Please confirm your email address to complete your registration with {{product_name}}.

Verify your email: {{verification_url}}

This link expires at {{expiry_time}}. If you did not request this registration, you can ignore this email.

Regards,
Account Security Team
{{company_name}}

templates.name: Password Reset
templates.trigger: When a password reset is requested
templates.subject: Password Reset Request
templates.body:
Dear {{user_name}},

We received a request to reset the password for your {{product_name}} account. Use the secure link below to choose a new password.

Reset password: {{password_reset_url}}

If you did not request this change, no action is required. You can contact {{security_email}} if you are concerned about your account.

Regards,
Security Team
{{company_name}}

templates.name: New Login Notification
templates.trigger: After a sign-in from a new or unrecognised device, according to account settings
templates.subject: New Sign-In Detected on Your Account

templates.name: Product Onboarding
templates.trigger: After account activation or when onboarding begins
templates.subject: Let’s Get You Started with {{product_name}}
templates.body:
Dear {{user_name}},

Thank you for joining {{product_name}}. Here are a few steps to help you get started:

1. Complete your profile.
2. Configure your workspace.
3. Explore the main features.
4. Review the getting-started guide.

Start here: {{onboarding_url}}

Our support team is available at {{support_email}} whenever you need assistance.

Best regards,
Customer Success Team
{{company_name}}

templates.name: Free Trial Expiring
templates.trigger: A configured number of days before a free trial ends
templates.subject: Your {{product_name}} Trial Is Ending Soon
templates.body:
Dear {{user_name}},

Your free trial is scheduled to end on {{trial_end_date}}.

To continue using {{product_name}}, review the available subscription plans and the features included in each plan.

View plans: {{plans_url}}

Your account will be handled according to the trial and subscription terms shown in your account.

Regards,
Subscription Team
{{company_name}}

templates.name: Subscription Payment Receipt
templates.subject: Subscription Payment Successful – {{invoice_number}}

templates.name: Subscription Payment Failed
templates.trigger: When a recurring subscription payment fails
templates.subject: Action Required: Subscription Payment Failed

templates.name: New Feature Announcement
templates.trigger: When a product feature or major improvement is released
templates.subject: Introducing New Features in {{product_name}}

templates.name: Scheduled Maintenance
templates.trigger: Before planned maintenance that may affect availability
templates.subject: Scheduled Maintenance – {{product_name}}

templates.name: Service Disruption Update
templates.trigger: When a service incident is confirmed or its status changes
templates.subject: Service Status Update – {{product_name}}

templates.name: Inactive Account Re-engagement
templates.trigger: When an eligible user has been inactive for a defined period
templates.subject: We’d Love to Welcome You Back to {{product_name}}
templates.body:
Dear {{user_name}},

It has been a while since your last visit to {{product_name}}. We’ve continued improving the platform and introducing features that may be useful to you.

Sign in to explore what’s new: {{login_url}}

For assistance, contact {{support_email}}.

Best regards,
Customer Success Team
{{company_name}}
